name: Curve Fever
tagline: Steer your worm. Never touch a trail.
description: Everyone steers a worm that never stops, leaving a trail across the same arena. Hold left or right on your phone to turn; crash into a wall or any trail and you are out. Each round you score a point for every worm that died before you, and now and then your worm leaves a gap others can slip through.
howToPlay: Hold the left or right button to turn your worm. It never stops.
Hit a wall or any trail, even your own, and you are out for the round.
Every worm that dies before you is a point for you. Most points after the last round wins.
